Explicit domains and ranges, finite/enumerable bound requirements and binder structure.
Quantifier binder/range/term constructor and logical body interface.
Universal quantifier range becomes an implication antecedent.
Existential quantifier range becomes a conjunction.
Predicate is a Boolean-returning function with requires, reads, decreases, body and opacity parameters.
Set domain carries bound-variable type, element type and finiteness.
Bounds discovery for quantifiers and finite comprehensions, allocation independence, finite possible values and collection/integer pools.

Bound-variable substitution, range wellformedness and image wellformedness under the range guard.

scope: Design research for a future Solidity specification feature. No source implementation, semantic-equivalence theorem or complete Dafny parity is claimed. Source line scopes are selected inspections, not whole-file audits.

upstreamFindings.finding: Dafny translates a set image extensionally using suitable typed bound values, range and output equality. Identity comprehensions have a simpler translation.
Dafny separately checks range wellformedness and image wellformedness under the range guard; extensional membership alone does not reproduce this discipline.
Bounds discovery tracks finite/enumerable domains and allocation independence. A finite possible-value type can establish finiteness without a bounded range.
Dafny predicates are Boolean-returning functions with proof-relevant interfaces, including reads and decreases; they are not merely textual aliases.

evidence.finding: Finite equality-membership folds Theory equality over listed terms.
holds_finiteMember equates membership with equality to a listed term under typed denotation.
Existing source forall/exists compile with typed primitive binders.
Existing finite membership checks every operand at one primitive sort, including keys of empty membership.
SpecCtx.old switches storage and ledger interpretation, disables memory snapshots and rejects nested old through the ensures flag.
Token-level enum/constant substitution currently bypasses clauses containing forall/exists or escaped identifiers; new binders need additional protection.

limits: Existing equality-membership preserves Theory equality for halting terms; two undefined observations may compare equal.
Existing typed quantifiers are not first-class collection quantification or collection values.
Line references describe the inspected baseline and can move as concurrent feature work is integrated.

proposedComprehension.syntax: key \in uint(x; 1, 2; guard), also int, bool and address; existing prefix equality-membership is unchanged.
firstMilestone: One explicitly declared primitive sort and one bound variable.
An explicitly finite literal-value domain checked at that primitive sort.
Identity image only: each admitted result is the bound primitive value itself.
Formula-valued membership only, without adding collection-valued terms.

denotation.notation: exists v : Value(p), v in literalDomain and holds(push(sigma, v), guard) and denote(key, sigma) = some(v)
denotation.notationScope: Value(p), push and some are schematic names for the existing typed value, context extension and observation interfaces; these are not proposed Lean declarations.
denotation.meaning: The domain is finite independently of the guard. Membership relates a successfully denoting key to a literal primitive value for which the existing guard formula holds.
plannedTheorems: A generic equivalence between the generated formula and the stated typed denotation.
Weakening compatibility for outer terms moved under the binder.
Alpha-renaming compatibility and no capture of outer names.
Finite-domain support and independence from duplicate domain values.

representation: Store domain literals intrinsically at the chosen primitive sort.
Compile the key and domain in the outer context; weaken them under a genuine typed value binder.
Compile only the guard in the extended context.
Use indexed variables or binder-aware parsed AST substitution, never raw textual replacement.
strictnessAndDefinedness: The key must denote an actual primitive value: equality against a typed value binder prevents an undefined key matching a literal value.
Literal-only domains avoid silently dropping undefined dynamic domain expressions.
Guards keep the existing formula interpretation, including its Theory equality for halting expressions; this does not establish Dafny wellformedness parity.
A stricter mathematical-expression interface needs explicit guard definedness obligations or a separately proved total guard fragment.
Any future dynamic-domain extension needs an explicit proof policy for each entry; requiring every entry to return a value is preferable to silently omitting malformed entries.
Empty domains still require static checking of the key and guard; invalid names, sorts, snapshots and literals must not be hidden by simplification.

boundedQuantifierExtension.boundary: Compile symbolically with existing typed formula binders; do not enumerate the full uint256 domain.

implementation.validation: 21 proved, 3 intentionally pending, 28 compiler errors and 1 explicit loop unsupported; exact-goal refutation checked separately.
implementation.limits: Membership-only identity filters over primitive literal values; guard Theory equality is retained, constants conservative, loop annotations unsupported. Predicates remain planned.

captureSnapshotAndImporterHazards.requirement: A binder sharing an outer parameter name must not capture the key or domain. Compile outer terms before extending the scope and weaken them by typed positions.

New binder syntax must receive binder-aware parsed constant/enum resolution, or conservative bypass/rejection of the existing token-level substitution. Test binders shadowing inherited constants and renamed locals.
A whole-comprehension old switches the applicable snapshot context; keep existing nested-old and old-memory rejection.
An old expression in the guard changes storage/ledger interpretation while retaining the logical bound value.
Extend name collection, literal validation, constant resolution, renaming, snapshot detection and printer/parser round trips for every new constructor.
Reject mixed primitive sorts, unbounded ledger integers used as primitive domain values, and reference-valued keys or domains before constructing a formula.

proposedPredicates.firstMilestone: Contract-scoped acyclic predicates with explicit primitive parameters and a Boolean formula body; for example Within(uint x, uint lo, uint hi) := lo <= x and x <= hi.
argumentBinding: Compile actual arguments in the caller context before introducing fresh typed formal parameters.
Use typed bound positions or a proved binder-aware substitution; do not replace identifier substrings.
Callers may pass explicitly interpreted storage or snapshot expressions as arguments.

strictnessChoice.recommended: Define a strict call by requiring typed value witnesses for every actual argument before checking the predicate body.
strictnessChoice.hazard: Naive substitution into a predicate that ignores an argument, such as a body true, can erase an undefined actual argument.
strictnessChoice.alternative: A deliberately non-strict logical macro interface is possible, but must be documented as such and distinguished from Dafny function calls.

initialRejections: Implicit storage reads in the declaration body
Implicit result, old or ledger references in the declaration body
proposedPredicates.boundary: This adds a small reusable source-specification facility, not Dafny reads-frame, opaque-function, recursion or total-termination parity.

cases: Boolean, signed, unsigned and address domains
Binder shares an outer parameter name
Predicate formal shares a caller name
Old inside a guard retains the bound value
Undefined key cannot match a literal value
Guard halting-term equality behavior is explicitly pinned or rejected by a total-fragment gate
Unused failing predicate argument follows the documented strictness policy
Malformed expressions even in an empty domain
Unbounded ledger values used as primitive domain values
Admission through real solc declaration identities

auditStatusAfterMilestone.reason: Literal-domain filtered membership does not establish first-class collection support or full Dafny parity; reusable source predicates remain planned.

filteredMembership: Use a domain intrinsically typed at primitive sort p; compile the key in outer context Γ and only the guard under the typed binder.
Thin.drop Thin.refl is the existing weakening for the outer key; Tm.denote_wk and holds_finiteMember supply existing proof interfaces.
Preserve finiteMember semantics unchanged. The new key-denotes-some-value requirement is deliberate and applies only to new syntax.
Extend binder-aware renameSpecSyntax and specFeatures. Body.resolveSpecValues currently protects forall/exists only and must protect any new guard binder.
Cover foldMap, names, usesOld, usesOldNet, Show.prec/fmt and Counterexample.specNums traversals.
Body.loopSpec has a narrower grammar; keep new loop-annotation forms explicitly unsupported until their typed lowering is implemented.
predicates: A source-only facility can expand earlier acyclic declarations into existing typed formulas without adding a runtime predicate environment to Contract.
Check every declaration, including unused declarations. Separate call heads from variable renaming and prohibit implicit state, result, old, net and free locals.
Introduce typed value witnesses for every actual argument, including unused formals; an unused 1/0 actual must not disappear.
Document source macro scope explicitly; no reads/decreases/opacity or recursive total-termination parity is implied.
